title: The regulation's pharmacist and intern administration paragraph, its age limit and its conditions
rule_summary: 105 CMR 700.004(B), headed Exemptions from Requirement to Register, provides at paragraph (9) that a pharmacist or a pharmacy intern is authorized to dispense by administration FDA approved mental health or substance use disorder treatment drugs to persons 18 years of age or older provided that: (a) the pharmacist or pharmacy intern is authorized to dispense controlled substances in accordance with M.G.L. c. 112; (b) such administration is conducted pursuant to a valid prescription; (c) such prescription is subject to reassessment at appropriate intervals as determined by the prescriber; and (d) such activity is conducted in accordance with guidelines adopted by the Department, which shall include, but not be limited to, requirements for: 1. specific drugs permitted to be administered pursuant to 105 CMR 700.004(B)(9); 2. training accredited by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, the American Council on Pharmaceutical Education or a similar health authority or professional body appropriate for the medications being administered and their respective patient populations; 3. current CPR certification; 4. maintaining continued competency regarding the populations served, medications administered and current guidelines; 5. pre-administration patient counseling; 6. dosing and administration of the medications only in accordance with manufacturer approved labeling; 7. administration of medication, including administration of controlled substances as necessary for the management of medical emergencies; 8. record keeping; and 9. reporting of adverse events.
exam_relevance: Tests that the regulation's own paragraph reaches FDA approved mental health or substance use disorder treatment drugs for persons 18 years of age or older, sits among the exemptions from the requirement to register, and conditions the authority on dispensing authority under chapter 112, a valid prescription, prescriber reassessment and Department guidelines whose required contents it lists.

authority.name: Massachusetts Department of Public Health regulations
authority.section: 105 CMR 700.004(B)(9), opening words and (a) through (d), read with the heading of 105 CMR 700.004(B)

numeric_facts.fact: minimum age of persons to whom the drugs may be dispensed by administration
numeric_facts.conditions: FDA approved mental health or substance use disorder treatment drugs under 105 CMR 700.004(B)(9)

common_confusions: Reading paragraph (9) as reaching testosterone, HIV prevention or sexually transmitted infection medications, when its words reach FDA approved mental health or substance use disorder treatment drugs.
Treating the Department's guidelines as optional, when paragraph (9)(d) makes conducting the activity in accordance with them a condition.

Assuming that dispensing by administration under paragraph (9) dispenses with the condition that the pharmacist or pharmacy intern be authorized to dispense controlled substances in accordance with M.G.L. c. 112.
verification_notes: Read on 2026-09-14 in the current text of 105 CMR 700.000 published by the Department of Public Health on mass.gov (the edition whose PDF was generated on 2024-02-02), including the heading of 105 CMR 700.004(B) and paragraph (9)(a) through (d).
